# llms.txt — Investment Framework Skill System

## Project Overview

`investment-framework-skill` is an AI-assisted investment decision system built on 13 investment classics (covering Buffett, Munger, Dalio, Soros, Howard Marks, Peter Lynch, etc.). It provides 6 core Skills (event analysis / fund analysis / asset allocation / cycle positioning / bias detection / China masters) and 4 periodic workflows (daily / weekly / monthly / quarterly).

Mission: Turn a one-person CEO's investment decisions into a structured, repeatable, bias-aware pipeline.

## Core Pages

- [README](https://github.com/lj22503/investment-framework-skill/blob/main/README.md) — Full documentation (Chinese)
- [README_EN](https://github.com/lj22503/investment-framework-skill/blob/main/README_EN.md) — English documentation
- [skills/](skills/) — 6 core Skills

## What it is

**One-liner**: 6 Skills + 4 workflows that turn investing from "intuition" into a structured pipeline grounded in 13 classics.

**Core value**:
- Structure: every analysis follows collect → select → judge → analyze
- Bias awareness: explicit bias-detection Skill
- Cycle awareness: dedicated cycle positioning
- Continuous tracking: 4 periodic workflows for daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence

**Target users**: Solo investors (one-person CEO), small investment teams, individual investors who want disciplined frameworks.

## 6 Core Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `fanli-analyzer` | Event analysis — 4-layer decomposition (collect/select/judge/analyze) |
| `fund-analyzer-pro` | Fund deep analysis — holdings/performance/risk |
| `asset-allocator` | Asset allocation — Merrill clock / risk parity / position advice |
| `cycle-locator` | Cycle positioning — Kondratieff / real estate / inventory cycles |
| `bias-detector` | Bias detection — loss aversion / herding / overconfidence |
| `china-masters` | China masters — Buffett/Munger/Dalio applied to China context |

## 4 Periodic Workflows

| Workflow | Frequency | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Daily Market Scan | Trading day 09:00 | Position advice + risk alerts |
| Weekly Industry Track | Mon 10:00 | Industry allocation advice |
| Monthly Portfolio Review | End of month | Rebalance advice + diagnostic |
| Quarterly Deep Research | Quarter start | Macro analysis + key industries |

## 8 Data Sources

| Source | Type | Use |
|---|---|---|
| QVeris API | Paid | Northbound flows / macro |
| Eastmoney API | Free | Index / stock quotes |
| Sina Finance API | Free | Real-time quotes |
| HKEX Disclosure | Free | Northbound / Southbound |
| NBS (National Bureau of Statistics) | Free | Macro economic data |
| PBOC Official | Free | Monetary policy |
| Qiemai MCP | Paid | Market-wide advisory strategies |
| Tiantian Fund API | Paid | Fund NAV / holdings |

## Installation

```bash
clawhub install fanli-analyzer
clawhub install fund-analyzer-pro
clawhub install asset-allocator
clawhub install cycle-locator
clawhub install bias-detector
clawhub install china-masters
```

## Invocation Examples

### Event analysis (Fan-Li system)

```
User: Analyze this event: PBOC announces 0.5% RRR cut
→ fanli-analyzer
→ 4-layer output: collect signals → filter noise → judge direction → actionable advice
```

### Fund analysis

```
User: Analyze E Fund Blue Chip Selected
→ fund-analyzer-pro
→ Output: holdings / performance attribution / risk metrics / benchmark comparison
```

### Asset allocation

```
User: Help me allocate 1M RMB with medium risk preference
→ asset-allocator
→ Output: Merrill-clock position / risk parity split / recommended funds
```

### Cycle positioning

```
User: What cycle are we in right now?
→ cycle-locator
→ Output: Kondratieff position / real estate cycle / inventory cycle / implied sector tilts
```

### Bias detection

```
User: Is my decision right? I'm thinking of going all-in on new energy
→ bias-detector
→ Output: identifies loss aversion / herding / overconfidence; reframes decision
```

### China masters view

```
User: How would Buffett see this opportunity?
→ china-masters
→ Output: Buffett-style / Munger-style / Dalio-style perspectives applied to China context
```

## Trigger Word Mapping

| User Says | Invokes Skill |
|---|---|
| "Analyze XX event", "What's your view" | `fanli-analyzer` |
| "RRR cut", "Oil price up", "This data" | `fanli-analyzer` |
| "Analyze this fund", "How's this fund" | `fund-analyzer-pro` |
| "Compare these X funds / strategies" | `fund-analyzer-pro` |
| "Help me allocate XX M", "How to distribute" | `asset-allocator` |
| "Current position size", "Add or reduce" | `asset-allocator` |
| "What cycle", "Kondratieff", "Inflection" | `cycle-locator` |
| "Recession allocation", "Recovery buys" | `cycle-locator` |
| "Is my decision right", "Any biases" | `bias-detector` |
| "All-in", "Leverage" | `bias-detector` |
| "Buffett's view", "How would Munger see" | `china-masters` |
| "How to do value investing" | `china-masters` |

## 13 Investment Classics (Foundations)

Buffett, Munger, Dalio, Soros, Howard Marks, Peter Lynch, John Templeton, Joel Greenblatt, Pat Dorsey, Bruce Greenwald, Seth Klarman, François Valeur, Aswath Damodaran.

## Quality Standards

- Structured pipeline (no skipped steps)
- Bias-aware (explicit bias-detection Skill)
- Cycle-aware (dedicated cycle positioning Skill)
- Data-source-aware (8 sources: 6 free + 2 paid)
- Disclaimer-first (does NOT provide specific buy/sell recommendations)
